text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Symboli Rudolf completely<n>immerses herself in
her training,<n>Narita Brian arrives to inform her<n>about
a problem on the student<n>council.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The general manager, not wanting to<n>be a burden to
the president she<n>respects, has asked to resign.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After some thought, Symboli Rudolf<n>asks the
general manager to come<n>and watch her run in the
Satsuki Sho.
